issues.title: Same streaming-partial-data crash class fixed in BalancedPerspectivesPanel remains in CausalGraphPanel's Details view
issues.description: The diff's fix guards `t.between` because partial-JSON streaming can deliver objects with missing fields, but `DetailsView` — which receives the same streaming preview whenever final data is absent, gated only on `variables` being non-empty — still dereferences `causalGraph.edges.length`, `causalGraph.confounders.length`, and `c.affectedEdges.join(", ")` with no guards. Clicking the "Details" toggle mid-stream before those arrays have arrived throws the identical TypeError the in-scope commit fixes, crashing the panel.
